title: Continuity on a Simon submanifold can be checked in charts
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞, let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold (Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) r M), let X be a topological space and F : ℝᴺ → X. Suppose that for every chart (V, W, ψ) of M of class r (Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ) the map x ↦ F(ψ(x)) is continuous on V. Then F is continuous on M.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (F : Rn N → X), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ F (ψ x)) V) → ContinuousOn F M
